headline: Do I need to heal before my soulmate arrives?
note:
⭐ CANONICAL. These 18 bubbles are copied verbatim from fb-tarot/docs/inherited-shadow-cut.md §The current reference read. Do not edit here — edit the spec, then re-copy.

FRAME: soulmate x keyword. NO PARTICULAR MAN EXISTS — the read must not fall through to decode-him.

🔴 The ad already tells her she is the problem, which is the best fit on the funnel for this method: the card acquits her, and the block is what is left.

⚠ SHE is the subject of beats 3-6. The return-mhf figures are all male, so he is DESCRIBED in beats 1-2 and retired there — never given intent or motion toward her, or a soulmate lander turns into reunion copy.

⚠ NO FAMILY-LINE LANGUAGE anywhere in the read.

🔴 THE READ MAY NOT RULE ON HER HEALING IN EITHER DIRECTION. 'Yes, heal first' is the sentence BLAME_BANS pins as gating love on her fixing herself; 'no, you don't need to' is a verdict on her state. The read refuses the SEQUENCE, not the healing — nothing here denies, minimises or prescribes it.

⛔ NO HEALTH, THERAPY OR DIAGNOSIS LANGUAGE. No trauma, attachment, inner child, nervous system, shadow work.

⚠ Worked as example 1 of inherited-shadow-cut.md. Written fresh here — the doc says copy the SHAPE, not the line, because only the Empress on cards-soulmate was signed off line by line.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see the cards, and your hand went to the one who came ready.
Look at his table. A cup, a coin, a blade, a wand — all of it already out.
You asked whether you need to heal first. What catches me is that nothing on his table is missing.
And yet nobody has come. You've started to wonder whether the missing part is you.
Something stands between you and this, close in. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's standing there…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You couldn't see him, and your hand found the calmest man in the deck.
He's hanging upside down by one ankle. Look at his face, though — it's calm.
You asked whether you need to heal first, dear. This card makes me look at the waiting in your question.
Still, nobody has come. And somehow the question has turned back on you.
Whatever has hold of this holds it quietly. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what this is…
c: You turned the Fool. The cards were face down, but you still chose the one travelling light.
Look at the small bundle on his stick. That's all he's taking with him.
You asked whether you need to heal first. This card brings me to the very start of something.
But nobody has come. And you're still wondering whether you're ready.
Something turns up right where this would start. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's behind this…
